scope.write: human-only evidence:annotate; immutable server candidates and separately gated releases
scope.read: existing source/screenshot/card scopes and same-org task membership
scope.vendor_sources: typed but blocked with vendor_source_not_enabled in first certificate slice
scope.preparation: unconfirmed/legacy_unconfirmed/confirmed/invalidated ReviewState pins can be rendered; release requires current confirmed requirement source binding
scope.release_retry: explicit existing job retry; delivery recovery only; cannot confirm evidence or alter approval
scope.source_privacy_review: submit reviewed_source_png_sha256 must equal server manifest source.source_png.sha256; checked by AnnotationService before job admission
scope.single_domain: Retain every actual one-domain complete response review round; only genuine historical decisions may omit a round.

renderer_protocol.framing: existing 8-byte big-endian JSON length followed by bounded UTF-8 JSON and PNG bytes; no filesystem paths
renderer_protocol.release_content: already marked candidate PNG content with footer removed; original crop and boxes are provenance references only and are never applied a second time
renderer_protocol.receipt: exact renderer protocol/profile/version/binary/font identity, plan SHA256, provenance SHA256, complete PNG descriptor, content pixel hash and root mapping hash
renderer_protocol.content_hash: SHA256 of ASCII annotation-rgb-v1 followed by newline, big-endian uint32 width and height, then row-major RGB8 content bytes.

arguments.reviewed_source_png_sha256: Sha256; explicit human privacy review of exact source PNG

evidence stamp.cost_basis: zero on admission; actual zero on completed job

evidence annotation release retry.cost_basis: zero on admission; actual zero on completed job
